title: Work Unit - NORMATIVE profile (structural + measured value domains)
description: STRUCTURAL profile plus the value domains measured across the 2,007-unit catalog on 2026-08-09. Everything asserted here is a form a validator or runner must be able to CONSUME: an id it can key on, a dependency token it can resolve, a path it can open on Windows and POSIX, a schema reference it can load. Cross-field and referential rules (sentinel names its own id, dependency target exists, no cycles) are NOT expressible in JSON Schema and live in platform/lib/wfdsl/semantics.py as SEM-001..SEM-006.

id.$comment: measured: 13 prefixes (IMP TST RES CNF WFA ADV CNL ARC AUD BLD SYN CC REL), 0 nonconforming of 2007

dependency_token.$comment: a unit id or a bucket id. Measured: 2,644 unit-id refs + 1,004 bucket refs conform; 41 refs across 40 units carry the bare prefixes ARC/WFA/CC/IMP and are UNRESOLVABLE - those units fail this profile by design.

tool_token.$comment: native tool (Read), scoped native tool (Write(command-center/research/**)), sub-shell form (Bash:python), or an MCP tool mcp__<server>__<method> where <method> may be a * family wildcard. The <server> segment forbids '_' on purpose so that two comma-packed tool ids in one array element cannot match (verified: 'mcp__a__b,mcp__c__d' is rejected, 'mcp__codex__codex-reply' is accepted).

execution_substrate.$comment: measured in the catalog: local-parallel 784, local-serialized 565, worktree-isolated 456, cloud-batch 202. The remaining four are the substrates named by the spec's scaling doctrine (_USER-PROMPTS.md:10574-10581) and by the catalog `defaults` block, kept so a runner has a closed set to dispatch on.

relative_artifact_path.$comment: repo-relative, forward slashes only, no drive letter, no leading '/', no '..'. A backslash or a drive letter makes the path unopenable on the cloud substrates; '..' escapes the artifact root.

schema_reference.$comment: must be LOADABLE: a repo-relative .json path or an absolute http(s) URI, with an optional JSON-pointer fragment. Measured: 159 of 2,007 units carry trailing prose (e.g. 'receipt.schema.json profile=council-runtime-module (required: ...)'). No validator can open that string, so those units fail this profile by design.

failure_class_token.$comment: lowercase kebab class token. Measured: 18 units carry a non-token value - 17 use the placeholder 'timeout-<n>s' (a template that was never instantiated) and 1 packs a severity plus a prose class list into one element.
